resources.string: Decorative illustration of a calm counter
Understand your scrolling. Take back your time.
PAICONS Self-Development counts detected moves to a new short video, right on your phone. Detected counts are kept separate from estimates, and each app differs in how reliably it can be observed.
Private by design · No account needed for tracking
With your permission, an Android Accessibility service notices when a supported short-video feed moves to a different video. The first video you see is not counted — only each move to a new one.
A detected transition is not proof that you watched a video. It means the app\'s screen changed in a way that matched our rules.
If something can\'t be observed reliably, it is not counted. Estimates, when available, are always labelled and never added to your detected total, goals or streaks.
Social apps change their screens often. Detection on each app is experimental until it passes testing, and Android may stop the service at times.
Set up mindful tracking in a few simple steps.
To count short-video transitions automatically, PAICONS Self-Development uses Android\'s Accessibility service. Please read what this means before deciding.

While enabled, Android lets the service see interface information shown in Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and TikTok — which can include on-screen text. We only use the layout of scrolling areas (position and size), and discard everything else immediately.
Platform name, time of each detected transition, and feed session times. That\'s it.
What we never save or send
No captions, comments, messages, creator names, video IDs, links, screenshots or recordings. Other apps are ignored entirely.
No one. This data is not sent to us or to any third party, and is not used for advertising.
Counting and analytics run offline. No account. Activity is deleted automatically after 30 days.
Only to show your own counts, goals, reminders and widgets. The service never taps, scrolls, blocks apps or changes settings.
Counting is not guaranteed. Detection can miss transitions or stop when apps update or Android restricts the service.
You can withdraw consent or turn the service off at any time in Privacy.
Open Android\'s Accessibility settings, find PAICONS Self-Development under installed apps or downloaded services, and switch it on. Come back here when you\'re done.
Uses Usage Access to show total time in these apps — not short-video time

When a feed was observed but individual transitions couldn\'t be resolved, PAICONS Self-Development may estimate them from your own recent detected rate on that platform. Estimates show a range, are never added to detected totals, goals or streaks, and are unavailable when there isn\'t enough evidence. Gaps where nothing was observed are never estimated.

Start a check, open a supported app\'s short-video feed and move to the next video twice. Nothing leaves your phone.
Waiting… open a supported feed and swipe to a new video twice.
Open Accessibility settings and switch PAICONS Self-Development on. Some phones turn it off after an update.
Set PAICONS Self-Development\'s battery usage to \"Unrestricted\" or \"Don\'t optimize\" in Settings › Apps › PAICONS Self-Development › Battery. You don\'t need to disable other protections.
Samsung: Settings › Apps › PAICONS Self-Development › Battery › Unrestricted. Also remove it from \"Sleeping apps\" in Battery › Background usage limits.
Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO: Settings › Apps › Manage apps › PAICONS Self-Development › Battery saver › No restrictions, and enable Autostart.
OPPO/realme/OnePlus: Settings › Battery › More settings › Optimize battery use › PAICONS Self-Development › Don\'t optimize. Allow background activity.
vivo: Settings › Battery › Background power consumption management › PAICONS Self-Development › Allow.
Apps change their screens. Detection may become unavailable on a new version until PAICONS Self-Development is updated. We won\'t count what we can\'t observe reliably.
If PAICONS Self-Development was force-stopped, Android won\'t restart the service until you open the app or re-enable it. Time in between shows as a gap — never as zero.
Note your phone model, Android version and the app version shown above, then contact support from the store listing. Please don\'t send screenshots of private content.
Android may restrict background behavior, a permission can be revoked, or an app may change its interface. A missing count is never proof that no videos were viewed.

Because this app was installed from paicons.com instead of Google Play, Android 13+ asks you to approve it first: open App info, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, confirm, then come back and turn the service on.

This version was downloaded from paicons.com. Subscriptions are sold only through the Google Play version. Every core feature here is free and complete.

Counts transitions to a new short video in Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels and TikTok, on your device only. It reads only the position and size of scrolling areas in those four apps and discards everything else. It never saves or sends captions, comments, messages, video IDs or screenshots, and never taps, scrolls or changes settings. Turn it off anytime.
It takes about 30 seconds. Just follow these steps:
Look under “Downloaded apps” or “Installed apps” (tap it if it’s a button)
How many short videos a day feels right? You can change this anytime.
Not sure? Start with Balanced. You’ll get a gentle reminder at 50%, 75% and 100% — nothing is ever blocked.
Follow these steps — it only takes a minute.
Agree to the privacy screen and switch tracking on.
Pick how many short videos a day feels right.
Open Reels, Shorts or TikTok, swipe to the next video, then come back here.
See your count without opening the app.
Counting runs on its own now. Check back anytime, and look at Insights after a few days.
Your history: switch between Today, 7 days and 30 days, or tap a platform to filter. Dashed bars mean tracking was off.
Set one daily limit for all apps, or one per app. You’ll get gentle reminders — nothing is ever blocked.
Pick a size and what it shows, then tap “Add widget to home screen”.
Check here if counting seems off. “Tracking active” means everything works; otherwise this page shows how to fix it.
